title: 第13章 萧火火 师父活了那么久肯定寂寞了给他找对姐妹花第14章 萧斩 我这蠢儿子连同龄人都能装世外高人骗他了
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 说著此番话的时候，簫火火是犹豫的。
毕竟师尊就是不喜欢外界的喧闹，才在此隱居多年。
也不知，师尊是否会愿意跟他回去。
楚风顺势从椅子上起身，环视了周遭一圈，嘆息道：
“也罢，为师也好长时日未曾见过外面的风景了，便是和你出去看看吧。”
“权当散散心。”
若是此前，楚风一定会拒绝离开。
毕竟此前他的一切，都是他自行编造出来的，没有一点实力。
但是如今，链气四层，也算是有著几分自保之力了，还能出去看看有没有別的气运之子。
而且，这种粗茶淡饭的乡野生活，他也是受够了。
簫火火激动万分：
“多谢师尊！”
二人在林中收拾了一阵，便是踏入了眼前的这片森林之中。
三日后。
一青一少二人同站在一处宽敞的大道上，同时看向前方。
在他们身前的，是一座古老的城门。
城门两侧，城墙左右延伸数里，青砖上布著不少蛛网般蔓延的裂缝，裂缝上又用夯土覆盖，层层叠叠，显是遭了许多年月的侵蚀。
城门大开，朝里头看去，便是能一窥东离城的风景。
那是一道宽阔的街道，左右两侧立著高大木楼，商铺接连而设一眼看去没有尽头。
商铺中，百姓们往返走出，將整个街道挤满，哄闹无比。
楚风左右看了一眼，感慨不已。
终於是来到了人类居住的城池！
眼前的一砖一瓦，都透著一种人气的清香，让他感到心安。
人类是群居动物，楚风又不真的是什么隱居的世外高人。
这几个月来，住在深山老林中，若不是有簫火火相伴，他都得疯。
那道密林確实很多猛兽，若是普通人从中闯出，恐怕十死无生。
不过，如今纳了九道灵气的簫火火都能轻易的杀穿里头的凶兽，又更何况链气四重的他？
穿越了快三个月的时间，他终於是踏出了那个鬼地方。
而这一切，还都得归功於簫火火这个傻徒弟。
若不是他天资聪慧，拿著瞎编的功法炼出了一身的灵气。
不然，他们都不知道还要被困多长时间。
注意到楚风满是欣慰的目光，簫火火一阵狂喜，手心冒汗激动不已，內心暗道：
“师尊这是对我，对我的家乡还算满意？”
他近乎手舞足蹈的，跟楚风介绍著眼前的一切：
“师尊，此处就是东离城。”
“东离城的吃食闻名於世，城中有著许许多多令周围城池百姓都流口水的美食。”
“对了，师尊若是看上什么就直接拿著！不必客气。”
“哪怕是看上了哪户人家的妻子或是女儿，火火也给师尊抢来！”
听著簫火火所言，楚风有些无语。
这个老实的傻弟子，此前还是个恶霸？
他轻轻的敲打了一下簫火火的额头，后者立即安静了下来。
content_en:
When saying these words, Xiao Huohuo was hesitant.
After all, Master just doesn't like the noise of the outside world, so he has lived in seclusion here for many years.
I don’t know if Master will be willing to go back with him.
Chu Feng stood up from the chair, looked around, and sighed:
"It doesn't matter, I haven't seen the scenery outside for a long time, so I just want to go out with you and have a look."
"Quan should take some time to relax."
If it were before, Chu Feng would definitely refuse to leave.
After all, everything he had before was made up by himself, and he had no strength at all.
But now, at the fourth level of chain energy, he can be considered to have some ability to protect himself, and he can go out to see if there are any other children of luck.
Moreover, he had had enough of this mediocre country life.
Xiao Huohuo was extremely excited:
"Thank you Master!"
The two of them tidied up in the forest for a while, then stepped into the forest in front of them.
…
Three days later.
A young man and a young man stood together on a spacious avenue and looked ahead at the same time.
In front of them was an ancient city gate.
On both sides of the city gate, the city wall extends for several miles. The blue bricks are covered with many cracks that spread like spider webs. The cracks are covered with rammed earth, layer upon layer, which shows that they have been eroded by many years.
The city gate is wide open, and if you look inside, you can get a glimpse of the scenery of Dongli City.
It was a wide street with tall wooden buildings on the left and right sides, and endless shops lined up one after another.
In the shops, people walked back and forth, filling the whole street with great noise.
Chu Feng glanced around and was filled with emotion.
Finally we arrived at the city where humans live!
Every brick and tile in front of him exuded a fragrance of popularity, which made him feel at ease.
Humans are social animals, and Chu Feng is not really a reclusive master.
In the past few months, living in the deep mountains and old forests, he would have gone crazy if he had not been accompanied by flutes and fires.
There are indeed many ferocious beasts in that dense forest. If ordinary people break out of it, they will probably die.
However, now Xiao Huohuo, who has absorbed nine spiritual energy, can easily kill the ferocious beast inside, let alone him who is at the fourth level of chain energy?
After traveling for nearly three months, he finally stepped out of that ghost place.
And all of this must be attributed to Xiao Huohuo, this silly apprentice.
If it weren't for his talent and intelligence, he would have developed a whole body of aura with the made-up exercises.
Otherwise, they don't know how long they will be trapped.
Noticing Chu Feng's eyes full of relief, Xiao Huohuo burst into ecstasy, his palms became sweaty and excited, and he thought to himself:
"Master, are you satisfied with me and my hometown?"
He was almost dancing as he introduced everything in front of Chu Feng:
"Master, this is Dongli City."
"Dongli City is famous for its food. There are many delicacies in the city that make the people in the surrounding cities drool."
"By the way, Master, if you like something, just take it! You're welcome."
"Even if you fall in love with someone's wife or daughter, Master will snatch Huohuo away!"
Listening to what Xiao Huohuo said, Chu Feng was speechless.
This honest, stupid disciple was a bully before?
He gently tapped Xiao Huohuo's forehead, and the latter immediately calmed down.
title_en: Chapter 13 Xiao Huohuo. Master must have been lonely after living for so long. Find him a pair of sisters. Chapter 14 Xiao Zhan. My stupid son can even pretend to be an expert in the world and lie to his peers.
